capabilities: Scan a source folder for filenames containing dates in the daily notes format
Create all missing daily notes via ribbon action or command
List missing daily dates with filtering and links to source notes
Watch for new source files and create daily notes automatically
Wait for Obsidian Sync completion before automatic creation
disambiguation: It does not copy or merge source notes' contents; it only creates the empty daily note Obsidian would normally create for that date.
extras: Sync detection relies on undocumented internal APIs that may break after Obsidian updates and is untested on mobile; the plugin runs entirely locally with no network requests. Not yet available in the community plugin catalog.
problem: When other apps or workflows create dated notes (voice memos, meeting notes, journal imports), Obsidian's daily notes core plugin only creates a note for the current day, leaving dates without daily notes.

relations.evidence: Queue automatic creation until Obsidian Sync on this device reports that it has fully synced

summary: Plugin that scans a folder of notes with dates in their filenames and creates any missing Obsidian daily notes for those dates.
